core/src/com/biglybt/core/download/impl/.rule: Active path calls scraper.scrape(actual announcer), then saved random tiers only if that returns null.

core/src/com/biglybt/core/tracker/client.rule: One announce set yields exactly one helper. General multi-set pairing/activation/best status stays unsupported.
Announcer scrape key is actual tracker_client.getTrackerURL plus torrent hash. Per-URL retained object creation is separate from active selection.
lastUsedUrl assigned before request and returned by getTrackerURL; count branch alone mutates retained scrape; initial helper URL/response absence does not justify fabricated counts.

include/libtorrent/biglybtc_tracker_resp.rule: Exact fixed128-byte terminal: actual URL SHA256/admission/global sequence/protocol/request and times/count validity. No helper group, current/best URL or pending-announcer state.

src/torrent.cpp.rule: Dispatch event is posted after actual tracker request queueing on torrent executor. Actual UDP success callbacks are later packet-receive turns. Error triggers next tier member itself. No extra request needed.

src/udp_tracker_connection.cpp.rule: Actual packet handler dispatches announce success with real count fields; no source clock is inferred from alerts. Immediate errors do not create successful count facts.

src/alert_manager.cpp.rule: get_all appends pending dropped-type notification under same mutex before handing all queued pointers to owner.

include/libtorrent/alert_types.hpp.rule: Typed tracker_announce_alert supplies actual handle, inherited local_endpoint/URL, selected protocol and event.

include/libtorrent/time.hpp.rule: LT high_resolution clock is not assumed identical to provider steady clock; no cross-domain timestamp comparison.
